conventions.step_schema: copy the fields: id, batch, slug, title, family, objective/acceptance, type(replace|add|repair), files:{view:[cmd], delete:[{path,why,snippet}], edit:[{path,anchor,find,replace}], add:[{path,content}]}, backend:{}, frontend:{}, verification:[3 cmds], parallel_safe, conflict_zone, est_min
conventions.step_id_format: b<NN>-s<N> (b01..b12, s1..s5) — 60 steps total, globally unique
conventions.conflict_zone_format: string of 5 prefixes separated by ' | ', one per step slot s1..s5 (s1..s5 in order). Each batch step may READ anything but may WRITE only inside its own prefix. Per-step conflict_zone added at synthesis (slice of this string).
conventions.router_ownership: web/src/App.jsx is the ONE shared route registry (866 lines, lazyWithRetry imports + route table). Per batch, the step that owns the batch's primary screen (first step of each batch, 'owns routes') is the ONLY step in that batch allowed to edit App.jsx; it adds lazyWithRetry import + route entry per new/renamed screen. All other steps of the batch hand their route-additions as a snippet inside their step (files.add) but do not write App.jsx themselves.
conventions.new_files_how_to:
mkdir -p for missing dirs first (`mkdir -p web/src/components/ui`). Create each new file with full final content in one heredoc: `cat > web/src/components/X.jsx <<'STITCH_EOF'
...full JSX...
STITCH_EOF` (or agent Write tool). New component = default export; registration = lazyWithRetry import + route entry, owned by the batch router step. New lib files = named exports, imported each by the owning step. No stub files, no 'TODO' bodies — file creation implies complete implementation (GATES.md phantom-pass rule).
conventions.global_css_ownership: web/src/index.css (1735 lines, M3 tokens today) is owned by b1-s2 for the full LUMINOUS GLASS token rewrite. Later batches edit index.css ONLY to move per-file inline <style> into shared classes (e.g. AURORA_CHIP_TINTS -> 3.13) — those steps list index.css as secondary edit with a line-anchored snippet; any two steps in the SAME batch may not both write index.css.
